faqs.a:
Goods seized pursuant to distraint warrant shall be sold at public auction after ten
               days' public notice by publication not less than two times in a newspaper of general
               circulation in the city. Such goods may be redeemed by the taxpayer any time prior
               to sale by paying such tax, penalty and interest as are due, together with such costs
               as have accrued from the seizure and preparation for sale.
(Code 1981, § 31-67; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002)
